WITH params AS (
  SELECT 2020 AS yr, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS status
),
v AS (
  SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
),
months AS (
  SELECT (CAST(CAST(params.yr AS VARCHAR) || '-01-01' AS DATE) + v.n * INTERVAL '1 month') AS month_start
  FROM params
  CROSS JOIN v
),
sales AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id AS cust_uid,
    CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = params.yr
    AND (params.status IS NULL OR o.order_status = params.status)
),
monthly_active AS (
  SELECT month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_uid) AS active_cust
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY month_start
),
monthly_returning AS (
  SELECT s.month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_uid) AS returning_cust
  FROM sales s
  JOIN sales p ON s.cust_uid = p.cust_uid
    AND p.month_start = (s.month_start - INTERVAL '1 month')
  GROUP BY s.month_start
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT m.month_start,
    COALESCE(a.active_cust, 0) AS active_cust,
    COALESCE(r.returning_cust, 0) AS returning_cust
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_active a USING (month_start)
  LEFT JOIN monthly_returning r USING (month_start)
)
SELECT
  month_start,
  active_cust,
  returning_cust,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(active_cust) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) > 0
    THEN (returning_cust * 100.0) / LAG(active_cust) OVER (ORDER BY month_start)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS retention_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_start;
